stories.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after government pressure
stories.blurb: Nvidia's board brought back Jensen Huang as CEO in what Bloomberg calls one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history. The reversal followed pressure from the Trump administration. The stock posted its biggest rally in decades on the news.
stories.why_it_matters: Political intervention in corporate leadership decisions is now shaping the AI industry's power structure.
stories.original_headline: Nvidia Rehires Huang in Stunning Reversal After Trump Push

stories.headline: Claude can now review your pull requests and ship fixes itself
stories.blurb: Anthropic's new Claude Ship lets the AI review PRs, fix failing CI checks, resolve merge conflicts, and even approve routine changes if your team allows it. Two new agents handle the work: PR Steward jumps in when tests fail or conflicts arise, while Claude Approvals can greenlight standard changes based on your policies.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agents are now doing the grunt work of code review and deployment, not just writing code.
stories.original_headline: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now

stories.headline: OpenAI and Cisco built a tool that patches Linux security holes without restarting
stories.blurb: Shirudo is an open-source runtime that lets security teams block exploits on running Linux systems while they roll out permanent fixes. In a test, a Codex-generated shield stopped a Java4Shell attack on Elasticsearch without taking the service offline. It uses eBPF to observe suspicious activity and apply targeted protections without waiting days or weeks for patches.
stories.why_it_matters: Teams can now protect critical systems from zero-day exploits without downtime or waiting for patches.

stories.headline: Google Search can now read your credit card bills and Drive files
stories.blurb: Google's adding Wallet and Drive to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode. Opt in and Search will answer questions using your spending history, documents, and chat logs—like surfacing which card gives you the best rewards or pulling info from scattered project files. You control which apps connect in Search settings.
stories.why_it_matters: Search stops being a generic oracle and becomes a personal assistant that knows your actual context.
stories.original_headline: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours

stories.headline: Amazon acquires Decart's chip optimization stack to speed up AI inference
stories.blurb: Amazon is buying Decart's optimization technology and hiring its founding team to make its Trainium chips run AI models faster and cheaper. Decart built a full-stack approach that optimizes both hardware and software together, which Amazon has been testing since 2025 on everything from language models to agentic systems.
stories.why_it_matters: Faster, cheaper inference means more companies can actually afford to run AI at scale.
stories.original_headline: Amazon to purchase Decart's AI optimization technology to advance chip and model innovation for customers
